function.name: currency_conversion_convert
function.description: Converts a specified amount of money from one currency to another at the latest rate. Unlike currency_conversion_get_latest_rate, which gets the latest conversion rate, this converts a specified amount at the latest rate.

from_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert from.

to_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert to.

amount.description: The amount of money that you want to convert. This is a float type value.

function.name: currency_conversion_get_latest_rate
function.description: Get the latest currency conversion rate from one currency to another. Unlike currency_conversion_get_rate, which gets the conversion rate at a specified date, this gets the latest conversion rate.

from_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert from.

to_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert to.

function.name: currency_conversion_get_rate
function.description: Get the currency conversion rate from one currency to another at a specified date. Unlike currency_conversion_get_latest_rate, which gets the latest conversion rate, this gets the conversion rate at a specified date.

from_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert from.

to_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert to.

date.description: The date at which the conversion rate applies. Default is the current date.
